data.content: Stop and explain what's different about TableScore compared to the other 3

The key difference is the element Mantine `Tooltip` wraps:

- [GameDayLink](src/components/GameDayLink/GameDayLink.tsx) wraps an `Anchor`, and [GoalieIndicator](src/components/GoalieIndicator/GoalieIndicator.tsx) wraps a `Flex`. Their `mouseEnter` tests pass.
- [PlayerWDLChart](src/components/PlayerWDLChart/PlayerWDLChart.tsx) wraps `Progress.Root`, not its sections. The test only passed after sending `mouseEnter` to the root.
- [TableScore](src/components/TableScore/TableScore.tsx) wraps Mantine `Text`, which renders a paragraph. In happy-dom, both `userEvent.hover` and the mouse events we tried left its tooltip hidden. The tooltip markup exists, but that doesn’t establish whether this is only a simulator limitation or a behavior issue in the component.

I stopped as requested. The latest run still had 9 failing `TableScore` tests; the last attempted test edit wasn’t validated, so its current state is unconfirmed.
